title: Safety Consulting
shortDescription: Expert safety consulting, OSHA guidance, and risk reduction strategies tailored to your daily operations.
longDescription: Get expert safety consulting, OSHA guidance, risk reduction strategies, and program direction tailored to your company and daily operations. We partner with you to identify hazards before they become incidents — keeping your people safe and your business in full compliance. Our consultants bring decades of field experience across construction, manufacturing, oil & gas, and general industry, so you can trust the advice you receive is grounded in real-world practice, not just theory.

title: Workplace Safety Training
shortDescription: Hands-on and classroom safety training to build worker awareness and support OSHA-aligned job performance.
longDescription: Hands-on and classroom safety training that builds worker awareness, improves safe habits, and supports OSHA-aligned job performance. We cover equipment operation, hazard communication, confined space entry, forklift certification, First Aid/CPR, and more — delivering every program onsite at your facility or virtually via live webinar. Our instructors tailor each session to your industry and workforce so training feels relevant, not generic.

title: Onsite Safety Inspections
shortDescription: Thorough job-site and facility walk-throughs to identify hazards and document corrective actions.
longDescription: Our safety professionals conduct thorough walk-through inspections of your facilities and active job sites to identify hazards, verify code compliance, and document corrective actions with clear priority ratings. Each inspection results in a written report that gives your management team an actionable roadmap — not just a list of problems. We focus on what matters most so you can allocate resources efficiently and demonstrate due diligence to regulators.

title: Compliance Audits
shortDescription: In-depth OSHA and regulatory compliance audits with a prioritized roadmap to full compliance.
longDescription: Our in-depth OSHA and regulatory compliance audits give you a crystal-clear picture of your current exposure and a prioritized roadmap to full compliance. We audit your written programs, recordkeeping, training documentation, physical environment, and PPE protocols against the latest OSHA standards — then deliver a comprehensive findings report with risk ratings and actionable next steps. Most audits are completed in one to two days on site.

title: Safety Program Development
shortDescription: Custom-built written safety programs, policies, and procedures tailored to your industry and workforce.
longDescription: A strong written safety program is the foundation of every compliant, high-performing workplace. We custom-build safety programs, policies, and procedures tailored specifically to your industry, workforce size, and regulatory requirements. From Hazard Communication plans and Lockout/Tagout procedures to full safety manuals and emergency action plans — we write programs that are practical, defensible, and built to be used, not filed away.

title: Trusted Safety Partner
shortDescription: Consistent, reliable safety support that acts as an extension of your own team.
longDescription: For companies that need more than a one-time engagement, BHG Safety Partners acts as a fully embedded extension of your team. We provide consistent, reliable safety support that scales with your operations — covering everything from routine inspections and training refreshers to incident investigation, regulatory correspondence, and strategic safety planning. Think of us as your on-call safety department, without the overhead of a full-time hire.
